line: The history of AI as a rhythm game: models take the stage on the beat, and a report card closes the show.
line_cn: 把 AI 发展史做成一局节奏游戏，模型踩着拍登场，最后发成绩单。

camera.move: Beat punch (zoom 0.8–5 % around centre, decays in ~0.16 s)
camera.expresses: the hit, felt in the frame
camera.serves: any accent; a slam; a count-in

camera.expresses: the frame breathing with the music
the whole stage as a game board
camera.serves: a pattern being set up; a crowd; a scoreboard

camera.move: Hard cut on the bar line + flash
camera.expresses: a new round, a new set

camera.serves: a rivalry; human vs machine; old vs new

camera.move: Shrink to thumbnail (a finished bit scales down into a slot)
camera.serves: a recap; "and then all of this happened"

camera.move: Vertical scroll of the set (floor to sky)
camera.serves: a leaderboard; growth; a tower of items

camera.move: Snap zoom onto one prop (hard cut to a 2× framing, back on the next bar)
camera.serves: a price tag; a number; a face reacting

labels: Display: a heavy rounded sans for Latin and numbers (e.g. Fredoka 700); a black-weight sans for CJK (e.g. Noto Sans SC 900); a hand-lettered face only for handwritten props (e.g. ZCOOL KuaiLe).
Telop text: white or yellow fill with an ink stroke ≈ 14 % of the font size painted under the fill (paint-order: stroke). Titles are built glyph by glyph so each character can pop in.

The telops are the subtitles. Round cards, corner banners, labels, prop text and judgement words carry the meaning; keep them short (≤ ~20 CJK characters on a banner line, ≤ ~12 on a plate; Latin runs ~1.6× wider). With narration, subtitles are telop plates at the bottom in the same outlined type, never a thin generic caption.
Hold every text ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s); a judgement word may be shorter because it is read at a glance.
motion: Idle = hop on the beat: a parabola per beat (8–30 px); neighbours hop on the off-beat so a crowd ripples.
Hit = squash: a damped wobble (~30 rad/s, ~0.35 s) after each hit; a small squash on every downbeat.
Entrances drop from the sky with ease-in and land exactly on their beat, so the sound lands with them. Crowds drop in one per beat or half-beat.
Pops use back-ease for anything appearing (cards, stickers, stamps, words); ease-in for exits. Nothing fades in slowly: things are either on or popping.

native_moves.name: Rounds with a card
native_moves.does: A 1-bar card (round number + name + a tag such as a year or a step) flies in on a jingle, then play.
native_moves.fits: the steps of a recipe; the stages of a startup; the chapters of a museum tour.

native_moves.name: Report card
native_moves.does: A typewritten recap with a grade stamp.
native_moves.fits: a quarterly review; a trip summary; a final score.

native_moves.name: Call-and-response
native_moves.does: Anything with a turn becomes a rhythm pattern; speeding up the pattern (quarters → eighths) is the plot.
native_moves.fits: a teacher's question and the class answer; a customer order and the barista's reply; ping-pong between two negotiators.

native_moves.name: Next-level tease
native_moves.fits: a next version; next season; a next grade.

native_moves.name: Judgement word
native_moves.does: A big outlined word pops at an angle on the round's last hit.
native_moves.fits: "Delivered!" on a logistics step; "Approved!" on a permit; "Personal best!" on a training plan.

native_moves.name: Remix board
native_moves.does: One set with a timeline ribbon; each item gets a few bars centre stage, then shrinks into a slot along the bottom; at a climax all slots bounce together.
native_moves.fits: a year in review; a team's release list; a festival line-up.

native_moves.name: Stats as game UI
native_moves.does: Numbers become podium scores, counters racing to a target, price tags getting hammered, bar charts that grow per beat.
native_moves.fits: fundraising progress; calories per dish; downloads of an app.

native_moves.name: Crowd drop
native_moves.does: Many contestants drop in one per beat, each with a pitched pip.
native_moves.fits: every member of a club; the planets; the ingredients of a dish.

score.note: all synthesized: square lead, saw brass stabs, slap bass, bright major loop
